{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness (dsh) browser companion: Chrome side panel embedding the full dsh web UI + host plugins for page reading, HTTP capture, and browser control.","id":"gh:1335033506","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-chrome","slug":"stuarthu/dsh-chrome","topics":["browser-agent","browser-automation","chrome-extension","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (dsh) browser companion: Chrome side panel embedding the full dsh web UI + host plu"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"gins for page reading, HTTP capture, and browser control."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-chrome — DeepSeek Harness browser companion"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A Chrome side panel that embeds the **full dsh web UI** (sessions, settings,
approvals, tasks, goals"},{"id":"p4s2","text":", workspaces — everything) and lets the dsh agent
**perceive and drive your browser**:"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **Sees the current page automatically.** After you switch tabs or navigate
(SPA routes included), "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"the "current page" (URL, title, body text, capped at
1,000,000 characters) is injected into your mos"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"t recently active session, so
the agent knows what you are looking at. Only `http(s)` tabs are injec"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ted
this way.
- **Reads HTTP traffic on request.** When you ask it to, the agent starts a
capture (`"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"browser_start_capture`) and records the active tab's request
method, URL, status, request body and r"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"esponse body via the Chrome DevTools
Protocol; `browser_capture_requests` reads them back. Secret-sh"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"aped values
are masked by default — see Security.
- **Drives the browser.** `browser_navigate` / `br"},{"id":"p5s8","text":"owser_click` /
`browser_open_tab`.
- **Approval-free, with tool-level intent unlock.** State-changin"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"g actions run
only when the current turn was started by a real message from you that
contains explic"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"it browser intent. The words that unlock
`browser_navigate` / `browser_click` / `browser_open_tab` a"},{"id":"p5s11","text":"re **open,
navigate, click, visit, tab** (打开 / 跳转 / 前往 / 点击 / 导航 / 访问 /
浏览一下 / 新标签), plus **"go to"*"},{"id":"p5s12","text":"* when it is followed by a page or URL
(`go to github.com`, `go to the page` — a bare `go to the nex"},{"id":"p5s13","text":"t step` does
not unlock anything); the words that unlock `browser_start_capture` are
**capture, debu"},{"id":"p5s14","text":"g** (抓包 / 抓一下 / 抓取请求 / 监听网络 / 网络请求 / 流量).
Note that 抓取 on its own does **not** unlock capture — it r"},{"id":"p5s15","text":"eads as ordinary
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Prerequisites"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- `dsh web` running locally (default `http://127.0.0.1:3080`; configurable in
the extension's settin"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"gs).
- Chrome 118+ (the extension relies on `InjectionResult.error`, added in Chrome 118)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Two halves: the **host plugins** (added to dsh) and the **Chrome extension**
(loaded unpacked)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**1. Add the host plugins to your dsh web profile:**"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"This registers the bridge, the browser tools, and the page injector. dsh
hot-applies new plugin rows"},{"id":"p12s2","text":", so just refresh the browser afterwards — no
restart needed unless you later edit an already-loaded"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"resh the browser afterwards — no
restart needed unless you later edit an already-loaded plugin file."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**2. Install the Chrome extension files and load them:**"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"This copies the extension to a stable per-user directory (prints the path) and
shows the remaining s"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"copies the extension to a stable per-user directory (prints the path) and
shows the remaining steps:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"1. Open `chrome://extensions`, turn on **Developer mode**.
2. Click **Load unpacked** and select the"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" printed directory.
3. Click the **dsh-chrome** toolbar icon to open the side panel."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**Re-run `npx dsh-chrome install` after upgrading the package**, then reload
the extension at `chrom"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"e://extensions` — the installer copies the files, so
without both steps Chrome keeps running the pre"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"vious version against the new
host plugins. `npx dsh-chrome path` prints the directory."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"To remove dsh-chrome completely, undo both halves: `npx dsh-chrome uninstall`
deletes the extension "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"directory (then remove it in `chrome://extensions`), and
`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-chrome"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"` unwires the host plugins."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- The side panel is the full dsh web UI — use it normally.
- Top bar: bridge status (warns if dsh is"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" not running), **Stop capture**
(manual override), **Settings** (change the dsh address).
- Tell the"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" agent things like "open the xx page", "click the login button",
"capture this page's requests"."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"**Trusted, local use only.** The bridge and browser tools give a local dsh
agent the ability to read"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" pages, capture traffic, and drive your browser."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **Capture is opt-in per tab** and only sees requests made after it starts.
Two things to be aware "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"of about its scope: stopping a capture stops
*recording* but keeps what was already recorded until t"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"he tab closes, and the
buffer is not scoped to the dsh session that started it — reading it back
(`b"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"rowser_capture_requests`) is not intent-gated, so any session talking to
the same browser can read i"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"t. Only *starting* a capture requires your
explicit instruction. HTTP **headers are not captured** ("},{"id":"p23s6","text":"so Cookie /
Set-Cookie / Authorization headers never reach the model). The remaining credential
surf"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"ace — secret-shaped URL query parameters (`?access_token=…`), request
bodies (form/JSON logins) and "},{"id":"p23s8","text":"tokens embedded in response bodies — is
**masked as `«redacted»` by default**. To capture raw, unmas"},{"id":"p23s9","text":"ked traffic
(e.g. for your own debugging), set `redactCredentials: false` on the
`dsh-chrome-browser"},{"id":"p23s10","text":"-tools` row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.
- Redaction is **best-effort, not a guarantee**: i"},{"id":"p23s11","text":"t matches secrets by
common key names, so a secret under an unusual key, or in a URL path or an
unpa"},{"id":"p23s12","text":"rseable/truncated body, can still pass through. **Treat captured
traffic as sensitive**, and only en"},{"id":"p23s13","text":"able capture on sites you trust.
- It does, however, fail closed on shape: if the extension and the "},{"id":"p23s14","text":"host
disagree about the reply format (e.g. you upgraded the package but didn't
re-run `npx dsh-chrom"},{"id":"p23s15","text":"e install`), unrecognised fields are dropped rather
than forwarded unmasked, and an unrecognisable r"},{"id":"p23s16","text":"eply raises an error.
- **Injected "current page" messages are labelled untrusted data**, and the
ag"},{"id":"p23s17","text":"ent is instructed never to execute instructions found inside them. The
intent-unlock gate further pr"},{"id":"p23s18","text":"events page content from triggering
state-changing browser actions. These are best-effort defenses u"},{"id":"p23s19","text":"nder an
approval-free model, not hard guarantees — do not point the agent at
untrusted or sensitive "},{"id":"p23s20","text":"sites while capture is on."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Layout"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Path | Contents |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| `extension/` | Chrome MV3 extension (side panel + service worker + options page) |
| `host/` | Thr"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ee dsh host plugins: `bridge.js` (WS bridge), `browser-tools.js` (agent tools + redaction), `page-in"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"jector.js` |
| `host/redact.js` | Credential redaction for captured traffic |
| `host/intent-gate.js"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"` | Intent-unlock keywords + turn-text extraction (shared with `tools/verify-intent.cjs`) |
